# 109 — Prime-time semigroup sampling boundary

**Record:** `ASFS-SCOUT-20260914-76`  
**Status:** `PRE-P0 STOP — PRIME TIMES INDEX A GENERAL SEMIGROUP ACTION; THEY ARE NOT GENERATED BY IT`

Ergodic formulations of prime-number-theorem phenomena can be mathematically strong while retaining primes only as averaging/sampling times. This record separates such prime-time sampling from an endogenous prime-symbolic action.

See [paper](paper.md), [scope card](candidate-card.md), [claim ledger](claim-ledger.md), and [evidence boundary](evidence/README.md).
